name: planwise
description: Agentic project management — plan, execute, review, and track projects with structured workflows

agent_guard.title: Agent guard
agent_guard.description: Checks planwise:task-runner dispatches only; other agents and calls pass untouched. report (default): log each finding and let the call proceed. deny: refuse a background task-runner spawn, refuse a bare cd or file-read Bash verb inside a task-runner, refuse a git verb that rewrites the shared working tree or index (stash, checkout, switch, reset, restore, clean, add, commit), and block a task-runner that stops unfinished. The spawn-prompt check only reports, at either value.

update_check.title: Update check
update_check.description: The session-start check for a newer planwise release. on (default): check the GitHub release list at most once every 6 hours and show a card above the prompt when the plugin or the project is behind. offline: check the local marketplace copy only, with no network call. off: no check and no card.
